Molt: A Scalable PyTorch-Native Training Framework for Agentic Reinforcement Learning

分类方向推理、智能体与后训练 / 后训练与对齐主题reinforcement learning
Jian Hu, Huiying Li, Hao Zhang, Binfeng Xu, Yifan Zhang, Shaokun Zhang et al.
high · 2026-07-22

为什么值得看 这项工作直接降低智能体强化学习研究中修改估计器、训练阶段和采样流程的工程成本：研究者可以沿一条异步训练循环端到端追踪并改动算法，同时保持生成令牌、策略版本和模型语义一致。它尤其适合需要频繁迭代算法、训练多模态或混合专家策略的研究者；在匹配的全异步协议下，作者声称其性能与基于大型并行变换器的现有训练栈具有统计可比性。

来源信号Hugging Face Daily Papers（社区点赞 👍 15）
代码
方法解读
01
问题

智能体强化学习中的算法改动需要同时穿透训练器、分布式后端和采样流程，导致研究迭代缓慢。

02
方法

框架采用原生深度学习代码和单一异步循环，统一处理智能体程序、策略训练以及多模态和混合专家策略。

03
差异

它强调研究者和代码助手都能整体理解的精简代码结构，并约束训练只使用智能体自己生成的令牌。

04
证据

在匹配的全异步训练协议下，作者报告其结果与基于大型并行变换器的训练栈具有统计可比性，并提供开源实现、配方和容器。

摘要

智能体强化学习研究经常修改算法、估计器、训练阶段和采样流程，而主流框架中的每次修改都要穿过训练器、分布式后端和采样连接层，工程成本最终由研究者承担。本文介绍一种原生支持深度学习框架的训练框架，强调代码精简、流程端到端可追踪，并通过一个异步循环训练多模态和混合专家策略，同时不使用智能体未生成的令牌；在匹配的全异步协议下，其性能与基于大型并行变换器的训练栈具有统计可比性。

Skill Self-Play: Pushing the Frontier of LLM Capability with Co-Evolving Skills

分类方向推理、智能体与后训练 / 后训练与对齐主题reinforcement learning
Siyuan Huang, Pengyu Cheng, Haotian Liu, Tao Chen, Yihao Liu, Jingwei Ni et al.
high · 2026-07-24

为什么值得看 这项工作把大语言模型的自我进化从单一环境或无验证的开放式生成，推进到由技能库组织的强化学习闭环：技能提供可核验的执行反馈，动态路由则扩大任务覆盖。对研究工具使用、推理和后训练的读者而言，关键价值在于一种不依赖人工逐题标注、同时控制错误奖励污染的训练机制；论文称其能提升已有能力模型的性能上限，并让起初不对齐的模型出现明显反转。

来源信号arXiv 收录Hugging Face Daily Papers（社区点赞 👍 23）
代码
方法解读
01
问题

方法针对自我进化中环境反馈可靠但任务狭窄、开放式生成任务广但难以验证的问题。

02
方法

提议者根据动态采样的技能生成挑战任务，求解器探索候选解，技能控制器依据执行反馈更新并扩展技能库。

03
差异

它用技能作为可验证场景与开放式任务多样性之间的中间层，并让三类组件通过连续自博弈共同进化。

04
证据

论文报告了工具使用和推理基准上的持续性能提升，以及起初不对齐模型的明显能力反转。

摘要

大语言模型训练正从人工设计和标注转向由交互驱动的自我进化，但现有方法在任务多样性与验证可靠性之间存在根本矛盾：依赖环境的方法反馈准确却局限于狭窄领域，开放式自生成扩大了任务空间却缺乏可靠验证，可能使误导性奖励污染训练闭环。本文提出技能自博弈，通过提议者、求解器和动态技能控制器组成的协同进化框架，在强化学习循环中持续共同进化，以技能提供可验证执行、以技能间动态路由保持开放式任务多样性；工具使用和推理基准上的实验表明，该方法能够持续提升已有能力模型的性能上限，并推动起初不对齐模型发生明显反转。

Integrated Order Dispatching and Routing for Last-Mile Pickup via Deep Reinforcement Learning

分类方向推理、智能体与后训练 / 后训练与对齐主题reinforcement learning
Yida Xu, Zhaofang Mao, Yuheng Miao, Jiaxin Zhang, Yiting Sun
medium · 2026-07-24

为什么值得看 它把路径规划模型从独立子问题提升为实时调度的可调用路由预言器，缓解端到端强化学习在大规模、变规模物流实例中的稀疏奖励和训练不稳定问题；对研究组合优化与强化学习结合、且关注线上决策延迟的读者尤其有参考价值。

来源信号arXiv 收录
方法解读
01
问题

该方法处理订单分配与车辆路径规划相互依赖的末端取件优化问题。

02
方法

它用动态残差图注意力网络和前瞻式个性化解码器学习路径预言器，再用预言器引导分配启发式与局部搜索。

03
差异

它没有把两个决策完全拆开或直接端到端训练，而是让学习模型提供候选快递员选择所需的近最优路径信息。

04
证据

在菜鸟物流真实数据的离线评估和在线滚动时域仿真中，作者报告其解质量和求解时间均优于其他基准。

摘要

末端取件日益复杂，订单分配与路径规划这两个相互耦合的决策过程若被分开求解会损失协同性，而完全端到端学习又可能因奖励稀疏而在大规模、变规模实例上不稳定且成本高。本文构建了一个将学习式路径规划预言器与实时分配启发式方法结合的集成优化框架：路径子问题采用动态残差图注意力网络编码器和前瞻式个性化快递员解码器，分配子问题采用由路径预言器引导并结合局部搜索的启发式方法。基于菜鸟物流真实数据集的离线评估和在线滚动时域仿真表明，该方法在解质量和求解时间上优于其他基准，可支持实时、大规模末端取件决策。

Explainable Reinforcement Learning for assisting Air Traffic Controllers

分类方向推理、智能体与后训练 / 后训练与对齐主题reinforcement learning
Anduel Mehmeti, Gabriella Gigante, Salvatore Venticinque
cites 2 · medium · 2026-07-24

为什么值得看 这项工作把强化学习决策解释带入空中交通管制这一安全关键场景，重点检验显著图能否揭示智能体为何选择避开禁飞区的航线。它适合关注可解释强化学习、人机协作和高风险部署的研究者，但当前证据仅来自简化环境和初步解释方法。

来源信号arXiv 收录
方法解读
01
问题

研究处理安全关键的空中交通管制中，强化学习智能体决策难以解释的问题。

02
方法

在简化的空中交通管制环境中训练强化学习智能体选择避开禁飞区的替代航线，并生成输入特征显著图。

03
差异

它把面向深度学习的显著性解释直接用于强化学习航线决策，而不是只评估决策结果。

04
证据

摘要只说明了初步测试和显著图分析，未报告定量性能、解释准确性或用户信任实验。

摘要

为将人工智能有效融入医疗、自动驾驶和航空等安全关键环境，并推进更高程度的自动化和顺畅的人机协作，建立对人工智能的信任十分重要，而信任与系统的可解释性密切相关。本文在空中交通管制这一安全关键领域，探索将可解释性技术应用于强化学习算法：在简化的空中交通管制环境中训练智能体，使其选择避开禁飞区的替代航线，并使用显著图初步分析哪些输入特征最显著地影响其决策。

Gaurav Dadhich
high · 2026-07-23

为什么值得看 这项工作把智能体记忆从单纯的存储检索问题扩展为覆盖记忆、作用域、预取、压缩和整合的生命周期管理问题，为降低长对话中的上下文成本与遗忘提供了系统设计框架；文中报告的长记忆评测和洛科莫评测结果也使其值得关注。

来源信号Hugging Face Daily Papers（社区点赞 👍 12）
代码
方法解读
01
问题

智能体需要在长对话、跨会话和组织层级范围内管理不断增长的上下文。

02
方法

方法将上下文管理拆为架构设计、摄入、作用域、预判以及压缩与整合五项基本能力。

03
差异

它不把记忆局限为存储与检索，而是加入按数据类型选库、保留来源、遗忘和预测后续需求等生命周期决策。

04
证据

参考实现按照该设计构建多租户服务，并在长记忆评测和洛科莫评测上分别报告百分之九十二和百分之九十三点二。

摘要

生产环境中的智能体失败往往不是因为推理能力不足，而是因为无法管理不断累积的对话历史、提示词、工具定义和工具输出，导致记忆遗漏与逐轮增长的词元成本。本文将主动管理智能体当前持有的信息定义为一种生命周期和架构问题，拆分为架构设计、信息摄入、作用域管理、需求预判以及压缩与整合五项基本能力，并指出朴素累积会使成本按对话长度平方增长，粗略摘要虽可降为线性成本却会带来准确率断崖，经过验证的压缩才能在保持保真度的同时实现线性成本；文中还介绍了多租户参考实现，并报告其在长记忆评测和洛科莫评测上的结果分别为百分之九十二和百分之九十三点二。

Multi-Head Latent Control: A Unified Interface for LLM Agent Decision Making

分类方向推理、智能体与后训练 / 推理与规划主题tool use / agent workflow
Amirhosein Ghasemabadi, Ruichen Chen, Bahador Rashidi, Di Niu
high · 2026-07-15

为什么值得看 这项方法把智能体的路由、澄清、工具调用和拒答决策统一为读取冻结模型隐状态轨迹的轻量控制层，避免为每个任务改提示词、加外部编排或微调主模型；在小模型加大模型路由中，论文报告可将大模型调用量最多减少百分之九十点七，同时保留大部分大模型性能，适合成本敏感且模型骨干经常更换的部署。

来源信号Hugging Face Daily Papers（社区点赞 👍 4）
代码
方法解读
01
问题

现有智能体控制主要依赖输入侧的提示路由、外部编排或任务专用微调，维护成本高且难以随模型骨干演化。

02
方法

方法在冻结的大语言模型或视觉语言模型上读取隐状态轨迹，并训练能力头与决策头输出路由和干预信号。

03
差异

它从模型生成过程的潜在状态直接推断控制决策，而不是仅依据输入或修改主模型。

04
证据

论文报告在安卓世界基准上大模型使用量最多减少百分之九十点七，在多项基准上平均减少百分之二十七至百分之五十三，并使工具调用决策相对得分最高提升百分之一百五十八。

摘要

大语言模型智能体需要在推理过程中判断是继续当前推理、交给更强模型、请求额外信息、调用外部工具，还是在当前条件下拒答。本文提出多头潜在控制层，从冻结的大语言模型或视觉语言模型的隐状态轨迹中生成部署时控制信号：能力头判断当前模型能否解决问题，决策头选择澄清、工具调用、拒答或直接回答；这些控制头仅使用同一冻结骨干模型的潜在轨迹训练，无需修改主模型，并在语言和视觉语言场景中改善多模型系统的质量与成本权衡。

Darshan Tank, Baran Nama
high · 2026-07-24

为什么值得看 这项工作提醒智能体研究者，技能不应只按平均成功率评估：技能可能因上下文渗透、输入落地方式被覆盖或输出核验被削弱而导致回归。对办公自动化智能体而言，优先改进落地与核验可能比继续优化流程指令更能提升可靠性。

来源信号arXiv 收录
方法解读
01
问题

研究技能加入后为何会让原本成功的任务失败，以及为何一些任务在有无技能时都失败。

02
方法

作者比较有技能和无技能的智能体表现，并结合运行轨迹分析技能描述渗透、落地置换和核验置换三种回归原因。

03
差异

该工作把总成功率拆成收益、回归和残留失败，而不是把技能效果压缩为单一平均提升。

04
证据

近六千次运行覆盖两个办公自动化基准和三个模型运行框架，结果显示较强技能主要是回归更少，并且许多错误可通过改进落地与核验恢复。

摘要

向大型语言模型智能体加入程序性技能时，通常只比较任务成功率的平均变化，但这一指标会掩盖技能带来的退化。作者在两个办公自动化基准和三个模型运行框架上进行了近六千次运行，区分了原本能完成、加入技能后失败的回归任务，以及加入技能前后都失败的残留失败，并发现可靠性更依赖输入落地和结果核验，而不是程序性技能本身的选择。

medium · 2026-07-24

为什么值得看 这项工作把企业智能体的权限控制从静态凭证配置前移为任务级的动态能力裁剪：通过角色上限、任务上下文分类器和策略组合禁令，在推理或误用发生前减少可调用工具。对研究智能体安全、工具使用和失配检测的人而言，观察模式还把不符合任务的权限请求转化为行为信号；但当前证据主要来自合成数据和策略迭代，尚未证明真实部署中的攻击防护效果。

来源信号arXiv 收录
方法解读
01
问题

企业智能体的静态凭证会让其在不需要时仍持有工具权限，从而扩大误用和攻击面。

02
方法

系统结合角色权限上限、任务上下文分类器和策略规定的权限组合禁令，并支持强制执行与仅观察两种部署模式。

03
差异

它将不存在于智能体上下文中的凭证视为预防性控制，而不是等智能体推理后再检测违规行为。

04
证据

六十条记录和六百八十八项决策的人审验证得到较高的柯恩卡帕一致性，策略迭代将上限违规减少百分之九十三。

摘要

企业智能体通常在配置时获得角色可能需要的全部工具凭证，形成持久的过度授权并扩大攻击面。本文提出动态最小权限原则及一个由角色上限、任务上下文分类器和策略组合禁令组成的三源架构，并发布包含六百条企业任务提示、十五类权限及最小权限标签的合成数据集；在六十条记录和六百八十八项决策的人审样本上，标注一致性较高，数据集与策略迭代还将上限违规从四十六次降至三次。

为什么值得看 这项工作为从零开始训练原生多模态模型提供了计算预算下的模型规模、令牌数量和数据配比选择依据：语言目标的资源分配规律较稳定，而多模态目标会随数据组成显著变化。对需要扩展视觉语言基础模型的研究者而言，其效率前沿和跨模态迁移结果可用于替代依赖经验的配方搜索，并解释何时应增加模型容量而不是继续堆积数据。

来源信号Hugging Face Daily Papers（社区点赞 👍 13）
方法解读

问题

方法解读
01
问题

从原始超声脉冲回波通道数据估计组织声速和衰减，同时降低对昂贵模拟标签的依赖。

02
方法

编码器先通过遮挡同相与正交区域预测进行无标签联合嵌入预训练，再在模拟声速图上微调。

03
差异

编码器采用直接处理复数信号的厄米视觉变换器，使注意力保持相位等变并使共轭乘积前馈层保持相位不变。

04
证据

在七万九千二百九十三个全波模拟样本上，一万份标签达到每秒十五点六米，并在低标签设置下取得约三倍至超过四倍的标注效率提升。

摘要

组织中的声速既是实现良好聚焦成像的前提，也具有诊断价值，但从原始脉冲回波通道数据中恢复声速属于根本性的非线性逆问题；学习式求解器速度快，却严重依赖标签，而模拟声速标签昂贵、真实通道数据却大量无标签。该方法先进行无标签预训练，使编码器根据可见上下文预测被遮挡同相与正交区域的潜在表示，再用模拟声速图微调；编码器直接处理复数信号，其注意力对相位偏移具有等变性，前馈层中的共轭乘积对相位偏移具有不变性。基于七万九千二百九十三个全波模拟样本的结果显示，一万份标签时误差为每秒十五点六米，标注效率约为监督训练的三倍，一千份标签时超过四倍；编码器特征还能迁移并显露声速与衰减信息，分层体模与腹部体模之间的跨分布预训练只带来很小的精度损失。

方法解读
01
问题

方法

差异

组织中的声速既是实现良好聚焦成像的前提，也具有诊断价值，但从原始脉冲回波通道数据中恢复声速属于根本性的非线性逆问题；学习式求解器速度快，却严重依赖标签，而模拟声速标签昂贵、真实通道数据却大量无标签。该方法先进行无标签预训练，使编码器根据可见上下文预测被遮挡同相与正交区域的潜在表示，再用模拟声速图微调；编码器直接处理复数信号，其注意力对相位偏移具有等变性，前馈层中的共轭乘积对相位偏移具有不变性。基于七万九千二百九十三个全波模拟样本的结果显示，一万份标签时误差为每秒十五点六米，标注效率约为监督训练的三倍，一千份标签时超过四倍；编码器特征还能迁移并显露声速与衰减信息，分层体模与腹部体模之间的跨分布预训练只带来很小的精度损失。

Molt: A Scalable PyTorch-Native Training Framework for Agentic Reinforcement Learning

CategoryAreaReasoning, Agents, and Post-Training / Post-Training and AlignmentTopicreinforcement learning
Jian Hu, Huiying Li, Hao Zhang, Binfeng Xu, Yifan Zhang, Shaokun Zhang et al.
high · 2026-07-22

Why it matters Molt targets a practical bottleneck in agentic RL: changing an estimator, rollout scheme, or pipeline stage normally requires edits across the trainer, distributed backend, and rollout glue. Its single asynchronous loop and end-to-end traceability could shorten algorithm iteration while preserving generated-token, policy-version, and model-semantic consistency, with claimed statistical comparability to a Megatron-based stack under a matched fully asynchronous protocol.

Source signalsHugging Face Daily Papers (community upvotes 👍 15)
Code
Method brief
01
Problem

Agentic RL experiments spread algorithm changes across training, distributed execution, and rollout integration layers.

02
Method

Molt uses a compact PyTorch-native codebase and one asynchronous training loop for multimodal and mixture-of-experts policies.

03
Difference

The framework treats the agent as an ordinary program and enforces training only on tokens generated by the agent itself.

04
Evidence

Under a matched fully asynchronous protocol, the paper reports statistical comparability with a Megatron-based training stack and releases recipes and containers.

Abstract

Agentic reinforcement learning research is constant algorithm modification, new estimators, new pipeline stages, new rollout schemes, and in mainstream frameworks each change threads through layers of trainer, distributed backend, and rollout glue: the cost lands on the researcher at every iteration. Molt is a PyTorch-native training framework built to keep that cost small: a codebase compact and clean enough for a researcher to hold in their head, and for an AI coding assistant to read and reason about in its entirety, so the algorithm flow can be traced and changed end to end. The agent is an ordinary program, and one asynchronous loop trains multimodal and mixture-of-experts policies while never training on a token it did not generate, consistent in tokens, policy versions, and model semantics. Leanness does not cost performance: under a matched, fully asynchronous protocol, Molt is statistically comparable to a state-of-the-art Megatron-based stack. Molt is open source and provides recipes and containers at https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/labs-molt.

Skill Self-Play: Pushing the Frontier of LLM Capability with Co-Evolving Skills

CategoryAreaReasoning, Agents, and Post-Training / Post-Training and AlignmentTopicreinforcement learning
Siyuan Huang, Pengyu Cheng, Haotian Liu, Tao Chen, Yihao Liu, Jingwei Ni et al.
high · 2026-07-24

Why it matters This work turns LLM self-evolution into a skill-organized reinforcement-learning loop rather than relying on one narrow environment or unverifiable open-ended generation: skills supply execution feedback, while dynamic routing expands task coverage. For researchers in tool use, reasoning, and post-training, the practical value is a route to reduce manual per-task annotation while limiting misleading rewards; the paper reports higher performance ceilings for capable backbones and marked turnarounds for initially misaligned models.

Source signalsarXiv indexedHugging Face Daily Papers (community upvotes 👍 23)
Code
Method brief
01
Problem

The paper addresses the tension between narrow but reliable environment feedback and broad but weakly verified self-generated tasks.

02
Method

A proposer generates skill-conditioned challenges, a solver searches for candidate solutions, and a skill controller updates and expands the skill library from execution feedback.

03
Difference

Skills serve as the intermediate unit that combines verifiable scenario execution with open-ended task diversity, while the three components co-evolve through continuous self-play.

04
Evidence

The paper reports consistent gains on tool-use and reasoning benchmarks and striking turnarounds for initially misaligned models.

Abstract

LLM training is shifting from manual design and annotation to interaction-driven self-evolution. However, existing self-evolutionary methods face a fundamental dilemma between task diversity and verification reliability: environment-bound methods obtain precise feedback but confine learning to narrow domains, while open-ended self-generation broadens the task space but lacks reliable verification, allowing misleading rewards to pollute the training loop. We identify agent skills as a powerful middle ground to reconcile this tension: each skill ensures deep, verifiable execution in a specific scenario, while dynamic routing across skills maintains open-ended task variety. Leveraging this insight, we introduce Skill Self-Play (Skill-SP), a co-evolutionary framework comprising a proposer, a solver, and a dynamic skill controller. Orchestrated via a reinforcement learning loop, these components co-evolve in a continuous self-play loop: the proposer generates challenging tasks conditioned on dynamically sampled skills; the solver explores candidate solutions to push its capability boundaries; and the skill controller collects execution feedback to update and expand the skill library. This interactive co-evolution effectively bridges the gap between structured verification and open-ended exploration. Empirical evaluations on tool-use and reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that Skill-SP, serving as a robust evolution engine, consistently pushes the performance ceiling of competent backbones while catalyzing striking turnarounds for initially misaligned models. Our code is available at https://github.com/Qwen-Applications/skill-self-play.

Integrated Order Dispatching and Routing for Last-Mile Pickup via Deep Reinforcement Learning

CategoryAreaReasoning, Agents, and Post-Training / Post-Training and AlignmentTopicreinforcement learning
Yida Xu, Zhaofang Mao, Yuheng Miao, Jiaxin Zhang, Yiting Sun
medium · 2026-07-24

Why it matters The paper turns a routing model into a callable oracle for real-time dispatch, addressing the sparse-reward and instability problems that make fully end-to-end reinforcement learning costly on large, variable-scale logistics instances. It is most relevant to researchers combining reinforcement learning with combinatorial optimization under latency constraints.

Source signalsarXiv indexed
Method brief
01
Problem

The study addresses the coupled order-dispatching and vehicle-routing decisions in last-mile pickup.

02
Method

It learns a routing oracle with a dynamic-residual graph-attention encoder and a look-ahead courier-personalized decoder, then uses it inside a dispatching heuristic with local search.

03
Difference

Instead of separating the decisions or training the full system end to end, the method uses learned near-optimal routing information to guide courier selection while preserving real-time scalability.

04
Evidence

Experiments on real Cainiao Logistics datasets include offline evaluation and online rolling-horizon simulation, with reported gains over benchmarks in solution quality and solving time.

Abstract

In recent years, the growing complexity of last-mile pickup operations has increased the need for fast and accurate decision-making on logistics platforms. This challenge is fundamentally driven by two key and tightly coupled decision-making processes: order dispatching and routing. Solving them separately overlooks their interdependence, while fully end-to-end learning can be unstable and costly on large, variable-scale instances due to sparse rewards. To solve this problem, we propose an integrated optimization framework which couples a learned routing oracle with real-time dispatching heuristics. For the routing subproblem, we develop a Dynamic-Residual Graph Attention Network encoder with a Look-Ahead Courier-Personalized decoder. For the dispatching subproblem, we develop a routing-oracle-guided dispatching heuristic with local search, where the oracle provides near-optimal solutions to select candidate couriers while retaining real-time scalability. Extensive experiments on real-world datasets from Cainiao Logistics are used to test the performance of our approach, including an offline evaluation and an online rolling-horizon simulation. The experimental results show that our approach outperforms other benchmarks regarding solution quality and solving time, indicating it can effectively support logistics companies in solving real-time and large-scale last-mile pickup problems.

Explainable Reinforcement Learning for assisting Air Traffic Controllers

CategoryAreaReasoning, Agents, and Post-Training / Post-Training and AlignmentTopicreinforcement learning
Anduel Mehmeti, Gabriella Gigante, Salvatore Venticinque
cites 2 · medium · 2026-07-24

Why it matters This work brings explanations for reinforcement-learning decisions into air traffic control, a safety-critical setting, and tests whether saliency maps reveal why an agent selects routes that avoid no-fly zones. It is relevant to researchers studying explainable reinforcement learning, human-AI collaboration, and high-risk deployment, but the evidence is limited to a simplified environment and a preliminary explanation method.

Source signalsarXiv indexed
Method brief
01
Problem

The paper addresses the difficulty of interpreting reinforcement-learning decisions in safety-critical air traffic control.

02
Method

It trains an agent in a simplified air traffic control environment to select alternative routes that avoid no-fly zones and produces saliency maps over input features.

03
Difference

It applies a saliency-based explanation directly to reinforcement-learning route decisions rather than evaluating only the resulting actions.

04
Evidence

The abstract reports an initial test and saliency analysis but gives no quantitative results for task performance, explanation fidelity, or user trust.

Abstract

To effectively integrate AI into high-stakes, critical environments such as healthcare, autonomous driving, and aviation--and to advance toward higher levels of automation and seamless human-AI collaboration--building trust in AI-driven solutions is essential. Trust, in turn, is closely linked to the explainability of AI systems. The rapid advancements in AI across various domains have underscored the challenges of establishing trust, raising increasing interest in AI explainability even more when applied to deep learning. In this context, the present work aims to explore the application of explainability techniques to Reinforcement Learning (RL) algorithms, specifically within the safety-critical domain of Air Traffic Control (ATC). Using a simplified ATC environment as an initial testbed, an intelligent agent is trained with a reinforcement learning algorithm to make decisions on alternative flight routes that avoid no-fly zones. As a preliminary explainability approach, a saliency map is employed, providing insights into the input features that most significantly influence the agent's decision-making process.

Agentic Context Management: Solving Agent Memory and Cost by Treating Them as Lifecycle and Architecture Problems

CategoryAreaReasoning, Agents, and Post-Training / Reasoning and PlanningTopictool use / agent workflow
Gaurav Dadhich
high · 2026-07-23

Why it matters The paper reframes agent memory as lifecycle control over context rather than only storage and retrieval, covering scoping, anticipation, compaction, and consolidation. This gives production agent builders a concrete route to control token growth and cross-conversation recall, with reported scores of 92% on LongMemEval and 93.2% on LoCoMo.

Source signalsHugging Face Daily Papers (community upvotes 👍 12)
Code
Method brief
01
Problem

Agents must manage growing histories, prompts, tool definitions, and tool outputs across conversations and organizational scopes.

02
Method

The design decomposes context management into architecting, ingesting, scoping, anticipating, and compacting and consolidation.

03
Difference

It adds lifecycle decisions such as type-specific storage, provenance preservation, forgetting, relevance selection, and anticipation beyond ordinary retrieval.

04
Evidence

A multi-tenant reference service implements the five primitives and reports 92% on LongMemEval and 93.2% on LoCoMo.

Abstract

Production AI agents' failures are less often due to an inability to reason well and more often because they cannot manage what is in their reasoning context: conversation histories, large prompts, large tool definitions, and ballooning tool outputs. Agents drown in their own accumulating history while paying a token cost that grows every turn, producing missing recalls within and across conversations. The incumbent response treats this as a storage-and-retrieval problem. We argue that framing is too narrow. Actively managing what an agent holds in mind is a lifecycle, not merely a store: it spans deciding what to remember, extracting and structuring it, choosing the right store per data type, consolidating and forgetting while preserving provenance, deciding what is relevant now, anticipating what is needed next, and compacting context to a budget without losing what matters. In serious production this operates not over a single user but across an organizational scope hierarchy. We name this discipline Agentic Context Management (ACM) and decompose it into five primitives: architecting, ingesting, scoping, anticipating, and compacting & consolidation. We then make the economic case: naive context accumulation grows token cost quadratically in conversation length, crude summarization buys linear cost at the price of an accuracy cliff, and only validated compaction achieves linear cost with preserved fidelity. We describe a reference implementation, Maximem Synap, that realizes the five primitives as a multi-tenant service and reports 92% on LongMemEval and 93.2% on LoCoMo under the configuration detailed in Section 6. We close with dimensions existing benchmarks do not yet capture, latency, token efficiency, and context-rot resistance, and the frontier of decision-level and organization-level context the category points toward.

Multi-Head Latent Control: A Unified Interface for LLM Agent Decision Making

CategoryAreaReasoning, Agents, and Post-Training / Reasoning and PlanningTopictool use / agent workflow
Amirhosein Ghasemabadi, Ruichen Chen, Bahador Rashidi, Di Niu
high · 2026-07-15

Why it matters This method turns routing, clarification, tool use, and abstention into a lightweight control layer over hidden-state trajectories from a frozen model, avoiding task-specific prompt orchestration or backbone changes. In small-plus-large model routing, the paper reports up to 90.7% lower large-model usage on AndroidWorld and 27–53% average reductions across benchmarks while retaining most large-model performance, making it relevant for cost-sensitive deployments and evolving backbones.

Source signalsHugging Face Daily Papers (community upvotes 👍 4)
Code
Method brief
01
Problem

Agent control is commonly handled by input-side prompt routing, external orchestration, or task-specific fine-tuning, which can be costly to maintain as backbones change.

02
Method

The method reads hidden-state trajectories from a frozen LLM or VLM and trains a Capability Head and a Resolution Head to emit control signals.

03
Difference

It infers decisions from the model's latent generation process rather than relying only on inputs or modifying the main model.

04
Evidence

The paper reports up to 90.7% less large-model usage on AndroidWorld, 27–53% average reductions across benchmarks, up to a 158% relative gain in tool-use score, and 65.5% fewer missed-required tool calls.

Abstract

Large language models are increasingly deployed as agents, but reliable agentic behavior requires more than next-token prediction. At inference time, it is preferred that an agent can decide whether to proceed with its current reasoning, defer to a stronger model, request additional information, invoke external tools, or abstain under the given setup. Existing approaches address these decisions through prompt-level routing, external orchestration, or task-specific fine-tuning, which primarily rely on input-side signals, and are often costly and difficult to maintain as model backbones evolve. We ask whether such control decisions can be inferred directly from a model's latent generation process. We introduce Multi-Head Latent Control, a lightweight layer that reads hidden-state trajectories from a frozen LLM or VLM to produce deployment-time control signals. A Capability Head predicts whether the current model can solve the instance or should defer to a stronger collaborator, while a Resolution Head predicts appropriate resolution decision Clarification, Tool Use, Abstention, or Direct Answering. Both heads are trained only on latent traces from the same frozen LLM backbone, enabling post hoc adaptation without modifying the model. Across language and vision-language settings, Multi-Head Latent Control consistently improves the quality-cost tradeoff of multi-model systems, enabling early handoff from partial generations and more accurate intervention decisions. In routed execution (small + large model), it reduces large-model usage by up to 90.7 percent on AndroidWorld and 27-53 percent on average across benchmarks, while retaining most of large-model performance. Additionally, the learned control signals improve tool-use decision quality, yielding up to +158 percent relative score gain and 65.5 percent fewer missed-required tool calls.

The Regression Tax: Decomposing Why Skills Help and Hurt LLM Agents

CategoryAreaReasoning, Agents, and Post-Training / Reasoning and PlanningTopictool use / agent workflow
Darshan Tank, Baran Nama
high · 2026-07-24

Why it matters For agent researchers, this paper changes the unit of analysis from average task success to net gains and regressions. In office automation settings, it suggests that improving grounding and output verification may yield more reliable behavior than adding more procedural instructions or choosing skills by their aggregate score.

Source signalsarXiv indexed
Method brief
01
Problem

The paper studies why adding a procedural skill can break tasks that an agent previously solved and why other tasks remain failures.

02
Method

It compares agents with and without skills across runs and traces, identifying skill-description osmosis, grounding displacement, and verification displacement as regression mechanisms.

03
Difference

It decomposes skill effects into gains, regressions, and residual failures instead of using one average success-rate change.

04
Evidence

Nearly 6,000 runs across two office-automation benchmarks and three model harness stacks show that stronger skills mainly regress less, while many errors are recoverable through better grounding and verification.

Abstract

Adding procedural skills to an LLM agent is typically evaluated by average improvement in task success. However, this metric hides an important cost: skills can also make agents worse. We measure both sides by comparing agents with and without skills across nearly 6,000 runs spanning two office automation benchmarks and three model harness stacks. This allows us to distinguish two outcomes. A regression is a task solved without skills but failed after skills are added. A residual failure is a task that fails both with and without skills. We find that regressions are substantial enough that the best performing skills outperform others primarily by regressing less, not by gaining more. We identify three causes of regression: (i) skill description osmosis, a skill changes an agent's behavior simply by being present in context, even when it is never invoked; (ii) grounding displacement, a skill's prescribed procedure overrides how the agent interprets its inputs; and (iii) verification displacement, where the procedure suppresses checks the agent would otherwise perform on its outputs. Analysing persistent failures reveals the same underlying pattern. Existing skills overemphasize procedural guidance the stage least often responsible for failure while under supporting grounding and verification, the dominant sources of remaining errors. After correcting evaluation artifacts and studying traces, we find many regressions and persistent failures recoverable through better grounding and verification. Procedural skills should be evaluated by decomposing their net effect into gains and regressions, not by aggregate improvement alone. We identify three regression modes skills should avoid, and find that reliability depends more on grounding and verification than on procedural skill choice.

Dynamic Capability Scoping for Enterprise AI Agents: A Synthetic Dataset and Three-Source Permission Architecture

CategoryAreaReasoning, Agents, and Post-Training / Reasoning and PlanningTopictool use / agent workflow
Halil Burak Noyan
medium · 2026-07-24

Why it matters This work moves enterprise-agent permission control from static credential assignment to task-level capability scoping: role ceilings, a task-context classifier, and policy-based combination prohibitions reduce available tools before misuse or misalignment occurs. For researchers studying tool-using agents and agent security, observe-only deployment also turns inconsistent permission requests into behavioral signals; however, the evidence is still based on synthetic data and policy iteration rather than real-world attack outcomes.

Source signalsarXiv indexed
Method brief
01
Problem

Static credentials leave enterprise agents with tools they do not need for a given task, increasing the misuse and attack surface.

02
Method

The architecture combines role-based permission ceilings, a task-context classifier, and policy-derived prohibitions on permission combinations, with enforcing and observe-only modes.

03
Difference

It treats credentials absent from the agent context as a preventive control instead of relying first on post hoc detection of agent behavior.

04
Evidence

Human review of 60 records and 688 decisions showed high Cohen's kappa agreement, while policy iteration reduced ceiling violations by 93%.

Abstract

Enterprise AI agents are typically granted static credential sets at configuration time, holding every tool the role might need for every task they perform. This persistent over-privilege expands the attack surface. We argue that capability scoping must follow a dynamic least-privilege principle and be treated as a prevention mechanism before a detection one. A credential that does not exist in an agent's context cannot be misused regardless of the agent's reasoning or evasion sophistication. We outline a three-source architecture instantiating this principle: role-based ceilings, a task-context classifier, and policy-derived combination prohibitions creating a layered proactive defense against LLM agent misalignment and misuse cases. The architecture supports both enforcing and observe-only deployment; the latter records agent permission requests inconsistent with task context, producing a behavioral signal usable in misalignment research. As a first step toward evaluating this architecture, we contribute a synthetic dataset of 600 enterprise task prompts grounded in a multi-department company policy, labeled with minimum required permissions across a 15-permission tool-based taxonomy that maps directly to deployable credentials or enforceable guardrails. The dataset is constructed via a two-pass pipeline that separates prompt generation from permission labeling to avoid circularity, and is validated against a 60-record/688 decisions human-reviewed sample (Cohen's $κ= 0.917$ pre-review and $κ= 0.967$ post-review). Iterating between dataset and policy reduced ceiling violations from 46 to 3, a 93% reduction. This shows that synthetic prompt generation can drive policy refinement when the two are developed together. The dataset, environment specification, and generation pipeline are released to support evaluation of dynamic scoping mechanisms.

ABot-World-0: Infinite Interactive World Rollout on a Single Desktop GPU

分类方向编译器、内核与硬件 / GPU/加速器内核主题accelerator / edge inference
Fan Jiang, Zhaoxu Sun, Mengchao Wang, Ziyu Zhu, Chiyu Wang, Yunpeng Zhang et al.
medium · 2026-07-21

为什么值得看 这项工作把长时闭环世界模型的部署问题具体化为单卡推理栈问题：通过轻量解码器、高效注意力、显存感知调度和低比特扩散变换器推理，在单张桌面显卡上达到七百二十像素视频每秒十六帧、动作到首帧一点二秒和约十九吉字节峰值显存。对做生成式视频推理、显存管理和实时交互服务的工程师，它提供了一个可参考的端到端部署组合，但论文主体仍包含大量模型训练与数据基础设施内容。

来源信号Hugging Face Daily Papers（社区点赞 👍 298）
代码
方法解读
01
问题

长时自回归世界模型在闭环交互中会累积分布偏移和生成漂移，同时需要满足实时视频推理的显存与延迟约束。

02
方法

系统通过世界探索器采集数据，用双向动作条件教师模型蒸馏因果学生模型，并以长时蒸馏对齐学生自回滚与扩展时域教师回滚。

03
差异

除了训练方法，系统还把键盘控制、角色记忆、质量筛选和显存感知流式推理整合到同一条数据与部署流水线中。

04
证据

在世界漫游基准和扩展交互回滚实验中，论文报告了具有竞争力的可控性与长时世界演化一致性，并给出单卡流式生成性能。

摘要

本文提出阿博特世界零，这是一个面向实时、长时闭环交互的动作条件视频世界模型，并构建了覆盖大型商业游戏、仿真引擎和互联网视频的多源数据基础设施。系统使用智能体驱动的数据采集、十四项确定性质量检查、视觉语言模型评估、同步动作与文本标注，以及从双向教师模型到因果学生模型的渐进蒸馏；长时蒸馏用于缓解自回滚中的分布偏移和自回归漂移。系统以原始键盘动作作为统一控制接口，并结合参考角色记忆维持第三人称交互中的身份外观一致性；部署端采用轻量变分自编码器解码器、高效注意力、显存感知调度和低比特扩散变换器推理，在单张英伟达五零九零型桌面显卡上可流式生成七百二十像素视频，最高每秒十六帧，动作到首帧延迟一点二秒，峰值显存约十九吉字节。

HEMERA: A Heterogeneous Memory-Centric Accelerator with Recursive Dataflow for Edge-Constrained State-Space-Duality Models Inference

分类方向编译器、内核与硬件 / GPU/加速器内核主题accelerator / edge inference
Hao Ding, Ling Liang, Ruitong Qiao, Dongxue Zhao, Xiantong Qiu, Jinshan Li et al.
high · 2026-07-24

为什么值得看 这项工作直接面向边缘推理硬件，绕开状态空间对偶计算中的二次中间结果和不规则数据搬运；它把稠密线性运算与递归状态更新分别映射到存内计算单元和流式引擎，为长序列模型部署提供了不同于常规矩阵内核的硬件路径。

来源信号arXiv 收录
方法解读
01
问题

矩阵形式的状态空间对偶推理会产生二次中间存储、非规则数据移动和带前缀依赖的状态传播开销。

02
方法

方法将矩阵计算改写为保持计算等价性的流式递归数据流，并采用存内计算单元与专用流式引擎的异构执行。

03
差异

它不再直接执行矩阵形式的状态空间对偶计算，从而避免二次中间结果并单独处理递归依赖。

04
证据

在一百三千万至二十八亿参数模型上，论文报告相对英伟达高端数据中心显卡官方融合内核的一点四至三点六倍延迟加速和十二点二至二十七倍能效提升。

摘要

结构化状态空间模型通过线性时间复杂度支持长序列建模，但状态空间对偶形式会带来二次中间结果、非规则数据移动和依赖前缀的执行，增加传统架构上的内存流量。本文将其改写为代数等价的流式递归数据流，并设计异构的以内存为中心的加速器，将稠密线性运算放入存内计算单元、递归状态更新交给专用流式引擎；在一百三千万至二十八亿参数的模型上，相比英伟达高端数据中心显卡上的官方融合内核，平均延迟加速达到一点四至三点六倍，能效提升达到十二点二至二十七倍。

Sparse by Command: Task-Conditional Compute Skipping for Multi-Task Inference Accelerators

分类方向编译器、内核与硬件 / GPU/加速器内核主题accelerator / edge inference
Afzal Ahmad, Gaoyu Mao, Shoubo Hu, Hui-Ling Zhen, Mingxuan Yuan, Xinyu Chen et al.
high · 2026-07-24

为什么值得看 这项工作把多任务推理中的任务命令变成硬件跳过计算的控制信号，而不是只在软件层做稀疏化；对需要低延迟、低能耗边缘推理的系统，它展示了从训练、指令集到加速器都围绕固定通道块协同设计的路径。原型在阿尔维奥优五十现场可编程门阵列上将计算量降低百分之六十六至七十六、延迟降低百分之五十一至五十九，并将每次推理能耗从二百六十三毫焦降至一百零八至一百二十八毫焦。

来源信号arXiv 收录
方法解读
01
问题

多任务模型对任务无关的网络计算仍然执行，造成不必要的延迟和能耗。

02
方法

联合训练主干网络与轻量门控网络，使其为硬件原生的通道块预测按任务生成的二值执行掩码。

03
差异

指令携带每个通道块的掩码字段，加速器可在无需软件干预和额外流水线改动的情况下跳过被屏蔽块。

04
证据

在阿尔维诺优五十现场可编程门阵列和卡拉闭环驾驶任务上，论文报告计算量降低百分之六十六至七十六、速度提升二点一至二点四倍。

摘要

多任务推理模型虽然共享主干网络，却会对不同任务执行相同计算，浪费能量和周期。论文利用推理前即可获得的任务命令，由轻量门控网络预测按任务划分的输出通道块执行掩码，并通过训练过程、带掩码字段的指令集和支持稀疏块执行的分块加速器实现硬件跳过；在卡拉自动驾驶模拟器的闭环视觉运动控制任务上，计算量降低百分之六十六至七十六，延迟从九点一二毫秒降至三点七四至四点四四毫秒，同时保持驾驶质量并降低能耗。

Mage-Flow: An Efficient Native-Resolution Foundation Model for Image Generation and Editing

分类方向编译器、内核与硬件 / GPU/加速器内核主题CUDA / kernel optimization
Xinjie Zhang, Peng Zhang, Shicheng Zheng, Jinghao Guo, Zhaoyang Jia, Yifei Shen et al.
high · 2026-07-21

为什么值得看 这项工作对图像生成基础设施的价值在于把轻量潜变量编码器、原生分辨率布局和堆栈级内核融合一起优化，而不是只压缩模型规模；据称可将训练吞吐提升约二点五倍，并让单张英伟达高端数据中心显卡上的高分辨率交互式生成达到零点五九秒。

来源信号Hugging Face Daily Papers（社区点赞 👍 72）
代码
方法解读
01
问题

大规模视觉生成器的训练、微调和部署成本较高，尤其受到潜变量标记化与高分辨率推理开销的影响。

02
方法

系统联合使用轻量高保真潜变量标记器、原生分辨率多模态扩散变换器、整流流匹配、强化学习对齐和对抗感知引导的少步蒸馏。

03
差异

它将标记器、生成骨干和系统内核作为一个整体设计，并支持基础版、对齐版和四步快速版的生成与编辑模型家族。

04
证据

摘要报告了标准生成与编辑基准上的竞争性表现，以及单张英伟达高端数据中心显卡上零点五九秒生成和一秒零二编辑的结果。

摘要

作者提出了一个四十亿参数规模的高效图像生成与编辑系统，由轻量高保真潜变量标记器和采用整流流匹配训练的原生分辨率多模态扩散变换器共同构成。潜变量标记器通过一步扩散式编码解码与锚点潜变量正则化，在保持重建质量的同时将标记化成本降低一个数量级以上；结合原生分辨率打包和堆栈级英伟达显卡内核融合，系统据称将端到端训练吞吐提升约二点五倍。该系统还提供基础版、强化学习对齐版和快速版，快速版可通过四步蒸馏实现低延迟推理，在单张英伟达高端数据中心显卡上以一千零二十四平方分辨率生成图像耗时零点五九秒、编辑图像耗时一秒零二。

SANA-Video 2.0: Hybrid Linear Attention with Attention Residuals for Efficient Video Generation

分类方向编译器、内核与硬件 / GPU/加速器内核主题CUDA / kernel optimization
Junsong Chen, Jincheng Yu, Yitong Li, Shuchen Xue, Haozhe Liu, Jingyu Xin et al.
high · 2026-07-23

为什么值得看 这项工作把视频扩散模型的注意力设计和单卡推理栈同时推进：混合线性注意力将大部分令牌混合降为线性复杂度，再用周期性软注意力恢复全秩交互；配合内核融合、缓存和稀疏注意力，论文声称在单张英伟达高端数据中心显卡上将七百二十帧高清生成管线推进到可用延迟，适合关注长视频推理成本的系统研究者。

来源信号Hugging Face Daily Papers（社区点赞 👍 34）
方法解读
01
问题

视频扩散变换器中的全软注意力会随视频序列长度产生二次开销，而纯线性注意力缺少充分的全秩令牌交互。

02
方法

方法以门控线性注意力进行主要混合，以周期性门控软注意力锚点刷新表示，并通过块注意力残差复用早期块摘要。

03
差异

该设计从头训练混合结构，而不是把已有全软注意力模型线性化，并以四比一的线性层与软注意力层比例控制质量和效率。

04
证据

论文报告深层有效秩提升约百分之十二、四百八十帧高清下评价分数为八十四点三零，并称编译后的前向过程在七百二十帧高清、六十秒视频上比全软注意力基线快三点二倍。

摘要

本文提出一种统一架构的视频扩散变换器，覆盖五十亿和一百四十亿参数规模，目标是在单张显卡上生成最高七百二十帧高清的视频。该方法以门控线性注意力承担主要的线性复杂度混合，并按四比一的层间比例加入门控软注意力锚点，再用块注意力残差传播已完成的块摘要；论文声称其质量可匹敌全软注意力视频扩散变换器，并在单张高端数据中心显卡上以四十步采样于四百八十帧高清下达到八十四点三零的评价分数和十三点二秒延迟，在七百二十帧高清、六十秒视频上比匹配的全软注意力基线快三点二倍，完整系统优化后五十亿参数管线在五秒视频上达到十三点零六秒。

Unified Static-Dynamic Pruning for Efficient LLM Inference

分类方向编译器、内核与硬件 / GPU/加速器内核主题CUDA / kernel optimization
Jinhyeok Kim, Yejoon Lee, Jaeyoung Do
cites 2 · high · 2026-07-24

为什么值得看 这项工作直接针对大语言模型自回归解码中的带宽瓶颈和稀疏计算不规则性，把静态权重剪枝与输入自适应剪枝统一到同一套格式和图形处理器内核中。对构建大规模服务系统的研究者而言，其价值在于同时覆盖预填充和解码阶段，并声称相较现有稀疏框架取得平均一点二四至一点三七倍、最高二点五一倍加速，同时在保持困惑度的情况下支持最高百分之二十五更高的稀疏率。

来源信号arXiv 收录
方法解读
01
问题

现有静态剪枝缺乏适应性，而动态剪枝会引入运行时不规则性，二者都难以同时优化大语言模型推理阶段。

02
方法

方法采用分块列式位图压缩格式，并配套带有激活感知动态共享内存位图解码的稀疏矩阵乘向量内核和面向预填充的张量核心稀疏矩阵乘法内核。

03
差异

它将永久移除的权重稀疏性与输入相关的运行时激活跳过结合，而不是只使用单一剪枝方式。

04
证据

在推理优化图形处理器上的综合评测中，方法相较稀疏推理框架取得平均一点二四至一点三七倍、最高二点五一倍加速，并报告了保持困惑度和最高百分之二十五更高稀疏率。

摘要

大语言模型的自回归解码受到低计算强度和带宽受限内核的计算与内存瓶颈影响。本文提出一种统一稀疏推理框架，将非结构化静态剪枝与输入自适应动态剪枝结合起来，并协同设计分块列式位图压缩格式以及面向解码和预填充的两类图形处理器内核；在推理优化图形处理器上的评测显示，该方法相较现有稀疏框架平均加速一点二四至一点三七倍、最高二点五一倍，同时保持困惑度并支持最高百分之二十五更高的稀疏率。

Stale but Stable: Staleness-Adaptive Trust Regions for Stabilizing Asynchronous Reinforcement Learning

Junyao Yang, Yucheng Shi, Zongxia Li, Zhongzhi Li, Ruhan Wang, Xiangxin Zhou et al.
medium · 2026-07-21

为什么值得看 这项工作直接针对异步强化学习系统中的策略滞后、推理引擎延迟和混合专家路由不一致，而不是只把吞吐量当作目标。它给训练系统提供一种按样本失配程度收紧更新的办法，在普通样本上保持原有行为、在高滞后样本上降低不稳定更新；这对采用解耦推理与训练的大模型强化学习集群尤其有用。

来源信号Hugging Face Daily Papers（社区点赞 👍 35）
代码
方法解读
01
问题

异步轨迹的策略滞后和路由不一致会使近端策略优化对高失配更新的控制不足。

02
方法

方法以采样对数比率作为陈旧性代理，并按批次内的陈旧性核缩放裁剪区间。

03
差异

它保留普通样本的基线区间，只收缩新出现的外向更新端点，而不是统一收紧所有更新。

04
证据

理论结果给出局部区间包含和逐点保守性，实验报告了不同滞后下的数学推理分数。

摘要

异步强化学习通过解耦轨迹生成与优化来提高吞吐量，但策略滞后、引擎延迟和混合专家路由会造成不可避免且不断累积的陈旧性，而近端策略优化的裁剪只约束采样到的外向更新，无法充分控制高陈旧性更新。文章提出陈旧性自适应信赖域，使用分离梯度的采样对数比率估计陈旧性，在批次内识别高失配尾部，并只收缩近端策略优化区间中由更新方向选定的端点；作者证明了区间包含关系和相对于近端策略优化的逐点保守性。在采用某三百亿参数混合专家模型、解耦推理与训练环境的实验中，该方法结合分组策略优化和路由重放，在不同滞后程度下取得了最佳的所报告数学推理评测结果。

TileSight: A First-Principles Tile-Centric Analytical GPU Performance Model from Cores to Clusters

Zhiwen Mo, Yu Cheng, Lei Wang, Zhengju Tang, Lei Xu, Guoyu Li et al.
2026-07-24

为什么值得看 该内容与AI 基础设施的当前追踪方向相关，建议结合原文判断实际价值。

来源信号arXiv 收录
摘要

Recent GPU programming frameworks such as Triton, TileLang, and CUDA Tile adopt tiles as first-class primitives, making tile-centric programming the prevailing approach for high-performance GPU kernels. Performance-analysis tooling has not followed: programmers still rely on coarse roofline bounds, opaque ML predictors, or post-hoc profilers to understand kernel execution. This gap is acute for modern AI workloads, where kernel fusion and distributed inference depend on tensor cores, CUDA cores, cache hierarchies, memory pipelines, and inter-GPU networks. We present TileSight, a tile-centric performance-modeling tool that elevates the tile from a programming primitive to an analysis primitive. Within a GPU core, TileSight models compute-memory pipeline overlap; across cores, it models the cache hierarchy; across GPUs, it models inter-node communication. All layers share the tile abstraction: the intra-tile layer expresses work as a resource vector spanning network, memory, and compute pipelines; the inter-tile layer schedules dependent and ordered actions to expose legal overlap and infers multi-level cache hit rates from tile reuse distance; and the cross-device layer maps remote tensor accesses to placements and routes them through an alpha-beta stage cost. On A100, H200, B200, and B6000, TileSight predicts single-GPU kernel latency with 12.35% pooled mean absolute percentage error (MAPE), outperforming state-of-the-art baselines and transferring better across architectures. Its L2 cache-hit-rate predictions are within roughly one percentage point of measurements on every GPU. At up to 32 GPUs, TileSight achieves 16.18% weighted MAPE (wMAPE) on fused distributed kernels and 13.52% wMAPE on end-to-end vLLM serving. In optimization, TileSight selects tile configurations competitive with strong vendor and expert baselines. TileSight will be open-sourced upon publication.

Agentic AI systems compose heterogeneous tool workloads on shared GPU/CPU infrastructure, yet existing frameworks assign all GPU-capable tools to the GPU by default. 摘要

Recent GPU programming frameworks such as Triton, TileLang, and CUDA Tile adopt tiles as first-class primitives, making tile-centric programming the prevailing approach for high-performance GPU kernels. Performance-analysis tooling has not followed: programmers still rely on coarse roofline bounds, opaque ML predictors, or post-hoc profilers to understand kernel execution. This gap is acute for modern AI workloads, where kernel fusion and distributed inference depend on tensor cores, CUDA cores, cache hierarchies, memory pipelines, and inter-GPU networks. We present TileSight, a tile-centric performance-modeling tool that elevates the tile from a programming primitive to an analysis primitive. Within a GPU core, TileSight models compute-memory pipeline overlap; across cores, it models the cache hierarchy; across GPUs, it models inter-node communication. All layers share the tile abstraction: the intra-tile layer expresses work as a resource vector spanning network, memory, and compute pipelines; the inter-tile layer schedules dependent and ordered actions to expose legal overlap and infers multi-level cache hit rates from tile reuse distance; and the cross-device layer maps remote tensor accesses to placements and routes them through an alpha-beta stage cost. On A100, H200, B200, and B6000, TileSight predicts single-GPU kernel latency with 12.35% pooled mean absolute percentage error (MAPE), outperforming state-of-the-art baselines and transferring better across architectures. Its L2 cache-hit-rate predictions are within roughly one percentage point of measurements on every GPU. At up to 32 GPUs, TileSight achieves 16.18% weighted MAPE (wMAPE) on fused distributed kernels and 13.52% wMAPE on end-to-end vLLM serving. In optimization, TileSight selects tile configurations competitive with strong vendor and expert baselines. TileSight will be open-sourced upon publication.

Agentic AI systems compose heterogeneous tool workloads on shared GPU/CPU infrastructure, yet existing frameworks assign all GPU-capable tools to the GPU by default. We formulate device scheduling as assigning each tool to one of three options: immediate GPU execution, queued GPU execution, or CPU offload, under a VRAM budget, and identify two runtime factors that cause end-to-end latency to diverge from static profiles: GPU utilization contention and VRAM capacity contention. We present an agentic scheduler that pairs an LLM agent with an algorithmic runtime monitor, where the monitor expands what the LLM can observe via running averages, symmetric reprobing, swap reprobing, and exploration hints, without ever prescribing which mapping to adopt. Across 13 scenarios spanning serial execution, parallel contention, and memory-constrained execution, the agentic scheduler reaches the brute-force optimal mapping in all 13 scenarios, matching the best classical baseline on mapping accuracy while avoiding bandit-style exploration over complete mappings, and outperforming HEFT, StarPU, and the all-GPU policy while requiring zero offline training.

ABot-World-0: Infinite Interactive World Rollout on a Single Desktop GPU

CategoryAreaCompilers, Kernels, and Hardware / GPU / Accelerator KernelsTopicaccelerator / edge inference
Fan Jiang, Zhaoxu Sun, Mengchao Wang, Ziyu Zhu, Chiyu Wang, Yunpeng Zhang et al.
medium · 2026-07-21

Why it matters This paper turns long-horizon interactive world-model deployment into a concrete single-GPU systems problem: a lightweight decoder, efficient attention, memory-aware scheduling, and low-bit DiT inference deliver 720P streaming at up to 16 FPS, 1.2 seconds from action to first frame, and about 19 GiB peak VRAM on one desktop GPU. It is useful to engineers building generative-video inference, memory management, and real-time interaction services, although much of the work remains focused on model training and data infrastructure.

Source signalsHugging Face Daily Papers (community upvotes 👍 298)
Code
Method brief
01
Problem

Long autoregressive world-model rollouts accumulate distribution shift and drift during closed-loop interaction while also facing real-time latency and memory limits.

02
Method

The system collects data with WorldExplorer, distills a bidirectional action-conditioned teacher into a causal student, and uses LongForcing to align student self-rollouts with an extended-horizon teacher.

03
Difference

It combines keyboard control, reference-character memory, automated data quality checks, and memory-aware streaming inference in one training and deployment pipeline.

04
Evidence

Experiments on WorldRoamBench and extended interactive rollouts report competitive controllability and coherent long-horizon world evolution, alongside single-GPU streaming measurements.

Abstract

We present ABot-World-0, an action-conditioned video world model for real-time, long-horizon closed-loop interaction, supported by a multi-source data infrastructure spanning AAA games, simulation engines, and internet videos to learn controllable world dynamics. WorldExplorer performs agent-driven collection guided by training feedback, while a unified pipeline applies 14 deterministic quality checks, VLM-based assessment, and synchronized action and text annotation. We progressively distill a bidirectional action-conditioned teacher into a causal student through teacher forcing and ODE distillation, and introduce LongForcing to align long student self-rollouts with an extended-horizon teacher, mitigating accumulated distribution shift and autoregressive drift. Raw keyboard actions provide a unified control interface for scene roaming and third-person character interaction, while reference-character memory provides persistent appearance cues for identity consistency during third-person rollouts. For deployment, we co-design a streaming inference stack with a lightweight VAE decoder, efficient attention, memory-aware scheduling, and low-bit DiT inference. Across optimized low-bit configurations, ABot-World-0 streams 720P video at up to 16 FPS on a single NVIDIA RTX 5090 desktop GPU, with 1.2s action-to-first-frame latency and approximately 19GiB peak VRAM. Experiments on WorldRoamBench and extended interactive rollouts demonstrate competitive controllability and coherent long-horizon world evolution.

HEMERA: A Heterogeneous Memory-Centric Accelerator with Recursive Dataflow for Edge-Constrained State-Space-Duality Models Inference

CategoryAreaCompilers, Kernels, and Hardware / GPU / Accelerator KernelsTopicaccelerator / edge inference
Hao Ding, Ling Liang, Ruitong Qiao, Dongxue Zhao, Xiantong Qiu, Jinshan Li et al.
high · 2026-07-24

Why it matters This work targets edge inference hardware and removes the quadratic intermediates and irregular movement created by matrix-form SSD execution. It separates dense linear work from recursive state updates, mapping them to in-memory computing units and a streaming engine instead of relying on a conventional fused matrix kernel.

Source signalsarXiv indexed
Method brief
01
Problem

Matrix-form SSD inference incurs quadratic intermediate storage, irregular data movement, and prefix-dependent state propagation.

02
Method

The accelerator rewrites SSD as an algebraically equivalent streaming-recursive dataflow and executes dense and recursive operations on separate heterogeneous units.

03
Difference

It avoids direct matrix-form SSD execution, eliminating quadratic intermediates while giving dependency-bound recurrence a dedicated streaming path.

04
Evidence

Across models from 130M to 2.8B parameters, the paper reports 1.4x–3.6x latency speedups and 12.2x–27.0x energy-efficiency gains over the official optimized fused Mamba-2 kernel on NVIDIA A100.

Abstract

Structured State Space Models (SSMs), such as Mamba, enable efficient long-sequence modeling with linear time complexity. Recent implementations realize this capability through Structured State Space Duality (SSD), which transforms recursive state evolution into matrix-form computations. However, SSD introduces substantial system-level overheads, including quadratic intermediate materialization, irregular data movement, and prefix-dependent execution, leading to excessive memory traffic and bandwidth demand on conventional architectures. Although prior accelerators mitigate these overheads through optimized dataflows or compute-in-memory techniques, they largely retain matrix-oriented SSD execution and cannot simultaneously avoid quadratic intermediate storage and efficiently map dependency-bound state propagation. This paper presents HEMERA, a heterogeneous memory-centric accelerator for efficient Mamba-2 inference. Rather than directly executing the matrix-form SSD computation, HEMERA reformulates it into an algebraically equivalent streaming-recursive dataflow that avoids quadratic intermediate storage while preserving the original computation. The resulting heterogeneous execution paradigm maps dense linear operations onto in-memory computing units and recursive state updates onto a dedicated streaming engine. Across Mamba-2 models ranging from 130M to 2.8B, HEMERA achieves average latency speedups of 1.4x-3.6x and energy-efficiency improvements of 12.2x-27.0x over the official optimized fused Mamba-2 kernel on NVIDIA A100. It further reduces the average SSD-related execution-time ratio across model scales to 14.12% during long-sequence inference, demonstrating its potential for efficient deployment under edge constraints.

Sparse by Command: Task-Conditional Compute Skipping for Multi-Task Inference Accelerators

CategoryAreaCompilers, Kernels, and Hardware / GPU / Accelerator KernelsTopicaccelerator / edge inference
Afzal Ahmad, Gaoyu Mao, Shoubo Hu, Hui-Ling Zhen, Mingxuan Yuan, Xinyu Chen et al.
high · 2026-07-24

Why it matters The paper turns the task command available before inference into a hardware scheduling signal, rather than treating sparsity as a software-only optimization. For low-latency, energy-constrained edge inference, it gives a full-stack path from command-conditioned training to tile-level ISA support and accelerator execution; an Alveo U50 prototype reports 66–76% fewer FLOPs, 51–59% lower latency, and energy falling from 263 to 108–128 mJ per inference.

Source signalsarXiv indexed
Method brief
01
Problem

Multi-task backbones execute task-irrelevant operations because their computation is not conditioned on the active task.

02
Method

A jointly trained lightweight gating network predicts command-dependent binary masks over fixed output-channel tiles.

03
Difference

Masked tile fields are encoded in instructions so the accelerator skips those tiles without software intervention or inference-pipeline changes.

04
Evidence

On an AMD/Xilinx Alveo U50 running a CARLA closed-loop visuomotor driving task, the reported speedup is 2.1–2.4x while driving quality is maintained.

Abstract

Multi-task inference models share a single backbone across diverse tasks, yet execute identical computation regardless of which task is active - wasting energy and cycles on task-irrelevant operations. We observe that the task command, typically available before inference begins, provides a free signal that can be exploited to skip unnecessary computation at the hardware level. We present a HW/SW co-designed approach in which a lightweight gating network, trained jointly with the backbone, predicts per-tile binary execution masks conditioned on the task input. Each tile corresponds to a fixed group of output channels (the native scheduling granularity of the accelerator), enabling masked tiles to be skipped with zero overhead. This yields a task-dependent reduction in compute, where each command activates only the subset of the network it requires, without changes to the model architecture or inference pipeline. We co-design the full system stack: a command-conditioned training procedure that learns hardware-aligned tile masks under a sparsity objective; an instruction set architecture whose instructions carry per-tile bitmask fields, allowing the hardware to skip masked tiles without software intervention; and a tiled inference accelerator with configurable parallelism, double-buffered memory, and INT8 datapath that natively supports sparse tile execution. We prototype on an AMD/Xilinx Alveo U50 FPGA and evaluate on a closed-loop visuomotor driving task in CARLA autonomous driving simulator. Task-conditional sparsity reduces FLOPs by 66-76% while maintaining driving quality. On-device latency decreases by 51-59%, from 9.12 ms to 3.74-4.44 ms (2.1-2.4x speedup), with energy per inference dropping from 263 to 108-128mJ.

Mage-Flow: An Efficient Native-Resolution Foundation Model for Image Generation and Editing

CategoryAreaCompilers, Kernels, and Hardware / GPU / Accelerator KernelsTopicCUDA / kernel optimization
Xinjie Zhang, Peng Zhang, Shicheng Zheng, Jinghao Guo, Zhaoyang Jia, Yifei Shen et al.
high · 2026-07-21

Why it matters For image-generation infrastructure, the key result is system-level co-design: a cheaper latent tokenizer, native-resolution packing, and stack-level CUDA fusion reportedly raise end-to-end training throughput by about 2.5x, while the 4-step Turbo models enable 1024² interactive generation on one A100 at 0.59 seconds per image.

Source signalsHugging Face Daily Papers (community upvotes 👍 72)
Code
Method brief
01
Problem

Large visual generators impose substantial training, fine-tuning, tokenization, and deployment costs, especially at high resolution.

02
Method

The stack combines Mage-VAE, a one-step diffusion-style latent tokenizer, with a native-resolution multimodal diffusion transformer trained by rectified flow matching, plus alignment and few-step distillation variants.

03
Difference

Rather than optimizing only the model, it jointly designs the tokenizer, backbone, resolution packing, and CUDA kernels and serves both generation and editing through Base, RL-aligned, and Turbo variants.

04
Evidence

The abstract reports competitive standard benchmarks, roughly 2.5x higher end-to-end training throughput, and 0.59-second generation or 1.02-second editing at 1024² on a single NVIDIA A100.

Abstract

Large-scale visual generators are increasingly capable but costly to train, fine-tune, and deploy. We introduce Mage-Flow, a compact 4B-scale generative stack for efficient text-to-image generation and instruction-based image editing. The stack is built from two co-designed components: Mage-VAE, a lightweight high-fidelity latent tokenizer, and a Native-Resolution Multimodal Diffusion Transformer trained with rectified flow matching. Mage-VAE uses one-step diffusion-style encoding and decoding with anchor-latent regularization, preserving the reconstruction quality of strong public VAEs while reducing tokenization cost by more than an order of magnitude. Together with native-resolution packing and stack-level CUDA kernel fusion, the stack supports flexible-resolution training and improves end-to-end training throughput by about 2.5times. Built on this foundation, we develop a complete model family with Base, RL-aligned, and Turbo variants for both generation and editing. Diffusion-NFT improves prompt following, text rendering, aesthetic quality, and editing fidelity, while few-step distillation with adversarial perceptual guidance produces 4-step Turbo models for low-latency inference. Despite its compact scale, Mage-Flow and Mage-Flow-Edit achieves competitive performance across standard generation and editing benchmarks. More importantly, the Turbo variants make high-resolution generation and editing practical for interactive use: at 1024^2 resolution on a single NVIDIA A100 GPU, Mage-Flow-Turbo generates an image in 0.59s, and Mage-Flow-Edit-Turbo edits an image in 1.02s, while maintaining a small memory footprint. These results show that careful tokenizer--backbone--system co-design can deliver strong high-resolution generation and editing within an efficient 4B model family.

SANA-Video 2.0: Hybrid Linear Attention with Attention Residuals for Efficient Video Generation

CategoryAreaCompilers, Kernels, and Hardware / GPU / Accelerator KernelsTopicCUDA / kernel optimization
Junsong Chen, Jincheng Yu, Yitong Li, Shuchen Xue, Haozhe Liu, Jingyu Xin et al.
high · 2026-07-23

Why it matters This paper links attention complexity reduction with an end-to-end video inference stack: most token mixing uses linear attention, while periodic softmax anchors restore full-rank interactions. The claimed results—3.2x faster compiled DiT execution at 720p for 60 seconds and a further 3.58x from kernel fusion, caching, and sparse attention—make it relevant to researchers reducing long-video generation cost on a single H100.

Source signalsHugging Face Daily Papers (community upvotes 👍 34)
Method brief
01
Problem

Full-softmax attention has quadratic cost over long video sequences, while pure linear attention loses full-rank token interactions.

02
Method

The system combines gated linear attention with periodic gated-softmax anchors and passes completed block summaries through Block Attention Residuals.

03
Difference

It trains the hybrid architecture from scratch instead of linearizing a pretrained model, using a 3:1 linear-to-softmax block ratio selected through proxy studies.

04
Evidence

The paper reports about a 12% increase in deep-layer effective rank, a VBench score of 84.30 at 480p, and a 3.2x compiled-forward speedup over a matched full-softmax baseline at 720p for 60 seconds.

Abstract

We introduce SANA-Video 2.0, a hybrid video diffusion transformer instantiated at 5B and 14B scales under a unified architecture. Designed to generate high-quality video up to 720p on a single GPU, SANA-Video 2.0 matches full-softmax video DiTs in quality while retaining the favorable long-sequence scaling of linear attention. To avoid quadratic attention throughout, Hybrid Linear-Softmax Attention combines gated linear attention for O(N)-dominated mixing with periodic gated-softmax anchors at a 3:1 ratio, restoring the full-rank token interactions that pure linear attention lacks. To propagate these refreshed representations across depth, Block Attention Residuals (AttnRes) route completed block summaries into later linear layers, enabling anchor-feature reuse and boosting deep-layer effective rank by ~12%. Through from-scratch training, SANA-Video 2.0 learns the complete hybrid directly rather than linearizing pretrained models, with reduced-resolution proxy studies establishing 25% softmax as the optimal quality-efficiency trade-off. With 40-step sampling, SANA-Video 2.0 achieves a VBench score of 84.30 in 13.2s at 480p on a single H100, remaining competitive with far larger softmax video DiTs at a fraction of the latency. Its compiled DiT forward pass is 3.2x faster than a matched full-softmax baseline at 720p/60s, a gap that expands with video duration. Furthermore, full-stack Sol-Engine optimization (kernel fusion, caching, and sparse attention) accelerates this hardware-friendly backbone by a further 3.58x, bringing the 5B pipeline to 13.06s at 720p/5s and making it 120x faster than Wan 2.2-A14B on one H100. Overall, our hybrid design recovers softmax-level expressiveness at substantially reduced cost, unlocking scalable long, high resolution video generation.

Unified Static-Dynamic Pruning for Efficient LLM Inference

CategoryAreaCompilers, Kernels, and Hardware / GPU / Accelerator KernelsTopicCUDA / kernel optimization
Jinhyeok Kim, Yejoon Lee, Jaeyoung Do
cites 2 · high · 2026-07-24

Why it matters This paper targets the bandwidth-bound, irregular kernels that dominate autoregressive LLM decoding by combining permanent weight sparsity with input-adaptive activation skipping. For GPU inference and serving researchers, the important systems result is coverage of both decoding and prefill through co-designed storage and kernels, with claimed average speedups of 1.24x–1.37x, up to 2.51x, over existing sparse frameworks while matching perplexity at up to 25% higher sparsity.

Source signalsarXiv indexed
Method brief
01
Problem

Static pruning lacks input adaptivity, while dynamic pruning adds runtime irregularity to LLM inference.

02
Method

The system uses a Tiled-Column-wise Bitmap Compressed format with a CUDA-core spMspV kernel for activation skipping and a Tensor-Core SpMM kernel for prefill.

03
Difference

It jointly exploits permanently pruned weights and input-dependent runtime sparsity instead of relying on either pruning mode alone.

04
Evidence

Evaluations on inference-optimized GPUs report 1.24x–1.37x average speedup, up to 2.51x, against sparse frameworks while matching perplexity and reaching up to 25% higher sparsity.

Abstract

The increasing deployment of large language models (LLMs) has magnified the computational and memory bottlenecks of autoregressive decoding, where low compute intensity and bandwidth-bound kernels dominate inference cost. Weight pruning offers a promising remedy, but existing methods remain confined to either static pruning (SP), which permanently removes redundant weights but lacks adaptivity, or dynamic pruning (DP), which adapts to input sparsity but introduces runtime irregularity. This paper presents SPDP, a unified sparse-inference framework that integrates unstructured SP with input-adaptive DP for efficient LLM inference on GPUs. SPDP co-designs a new Tiled-Column-wise Bitmap Compressed (Tiled-CBC) format and two complementary GPU kernels: (1) a CUDA-core spMspV kernel featuring Hybrid Activation-aware Dynamic Shared-Memory Bitmap Decoding (HAD-SMBD) for fine-grained, runtime activation skipping, and (2) a Tensor-Core SpMM kernel optimized for prefill computation. 01 / 论文

📄 论文

主题tool use / function calling

01
论文 / 高优先级

Skill Self-Play: Pushing the Frontier of LLM Capability with Co-Evolving Skills

分类主题tool use / function calling
Siyuan Huang, Pengyu Cheng, Haotian Liu, Tao Chen, Yihao Liu, Jingwei Ni et al.
high · 2026-07-24

为什么值得看 它用可验证的技能执行约束开放式任务生成，再通过技能动态路由扩大任务分布，为工具调用与推理代理提供了一条减少错误奖励污染、同时持续提升能力的自进化路径。

来源信号arXiv 收录Hugging Face Daily Papers（社区点赞 👍 23）
代码
方法解读
01
问题

现有自进化方法难以同时获得广泛任务多样性和可靠的结果验证。

02
方法

技能自博弈由任务提议器、解题器和动态技能控制器组成，并在强化学习循环中共同更新。

03
差异

每项技能负责特定场景中的可验证执行，而控制器负责动态采样、收集反馈并扩展技能库。

04
证据

在工具使用和推理基准上，作者称该方法能持续提高已有模型的性能上限，并让初始失配模型出现明显反转。

摘要

现有基于环境的自进化方法反馈准确但任务范围狭窄，开放式自生成方法任务空间更广却缺少可靠验证，错误奖励可能污染训练过程。本文提出技能自博弈，由任务提议器、解题器和动态技能控制器在强化学习循环中协同进化，以技能的可验证执行结合动态路由来兼顾结构化验证与开放式探索，并在工具使用和推理基准上进行评估。

潜力 60新颖度workload开源度洞见呈现机构信号
12 位作者2 所机构11 条合作线
02
论文 / 高优先级

Multi-Head Latent Control: A Unified Interface for LLM Agent Decision Making

分类主题tool use / function calling
Amirhosein Ghasemabadi, Ruichen Chen, Bahador Rashidi, Di Niu
high · 2026-07-15

为什么值得看 它让冻结的语言或视觉语言模型从自身隐藏状态中直接判断是否继续推理、转交更强模型、澄清、调用工具或拒答，从而减少外部编排与大模型调用，并在安卓世界最多减少90.7%的大模型使用、同时改善工具调用决策。

来源信号Hugging Face Daily Papers（社区点赞 👍 4）
代码
方法解读
01
问题

现有代理控制主要依赖提示词路由、外部编排或任务专用微调，难以随模型骨干演进而维护。

02
方法

方法在冻结模型的隐藏状态轨迹上训练能力头和决策头，分别预测是否需要转交以及澄清、工具调用、拒答或直接回答。

03
差异

该方法在不修改模型参数的情况下，通过生成过程中的潜在信号进行部署时控制，而不是只依据输入侧特征。

04
证据

在语言和视觉语言任务中，论文声称该方法改善多模型系统的质量—成本权衡，并提升工具调用分数最多158%、减少漏掉必要工具调用的情况65.5%。

摘要

论文研究如何从大语言模型的潜在生成过程中直接推断代理控制决策，并提出一个读取冻结语言或视觉语言模型隐藏状态轨迹的轻量层。该层用能力头判断是否应转交更强模型，用决策头判断澄清、工具调用、拒答或直接回答；在多项语言和视觉语言实验中，它减少大模型调用并改善工具使用决策。

潜力 43新颖度workload开源度洞见呈现机构信号
4 位作者1 所机构6 条合作线

主题other

03
论文 / 高优先级

Molt: A Scalable PyTorch-Native Training Framework for Agentic Reinforcement Learning

Jian Hu, Huiying Li, Hao Zhang, Binfeng Xu, Yifan Zhang, Shaokun Zhang et al.
high · 2026-07-22

为什么值得看 它把智能体强化学习中的算法迭代、异步采样和分布式训练收进一个研究者与代码助手都能整体理解的轻量框架，降低修改训练流程的成本，同时声称在严格匹配的异步协议下达到与主流大型训练栈统计相当的性能。

来源信号Hugging Face Daily Papers（社区点赞 👍 15）
代码
方法解读
01
问题

现有主流框架把估计器、流水线、采样方案的每次改动分散到训练器、分布式后端和 rollout 胶水代码中。

02
方法

Molt 使用原生 PyTorch 实现紧凑代码库，并以一个异步循环训练多模态策略和混合专家策略。

03
差异

智能体被实现为普通程序，训练过程保持生成令牌、策略版本和模型语义一致，且不使用智能体未生成的令牌训练。

04
证据

在匹配的全异步协议下，Molt 的表现与基于 Megatron 的主流训练栈在统计上相当，并提供开源代码、配方和容器。

摘要

智能体强化学习研究需要频繁修改算法、估计器、训练阶段和采样流程，而主流框架通常让这些改动跨越训练器、分布式后端和采样代码。Molt 是一个原生 PyTorch 训练框架，通过紧凑且端到端可追踪的代码支持多模态和混合专家策略的异步训练，并保持令牌、策略版本和模型语义一致；摘要声称它在匹配的全异步协议下与基于 Megatron 的训练栈表现具有统计可比性。

11 位作者0 所机构55 条合作线

主题memory / RAG agents

04
论文 / 高优先级

Agentic Context Management: Solving Agent Memory and Cost by Treating Them as Lifecycle and Architecture Problems

分类主题memory / RAG agents
Gaurav Dadhich
high · 2026-07-23

为什么值得看 它把代理记忆从单纯的存储检索改成覆盖记忆、分层存储、预测、压缩与遗忘的生命周期管理，并声称在长记忆任务上达到百分之九十二和百分之九十三点二，为降低多轮代理的上下文成本与记忆衰减提供了可落地的系统框架。

来源信号Hugging Face Daily Papers（社区点赞 👍 12）
代码
方法解读
01
问题

生产代理会因历史、提示词、工具定义和工具输出持续膨胀而出现记忆缺失与逐轮增加的标记成本。

02
方法

方法将上下文管理拆为架构设计、信息摄取、范围划分、需求预判以及压缩与整合五个基本操作。

03
差异

它把上下文视为跨用户和组织层级运作的生命周期对象，而不是仅由一个存储检索系统处理的数据。

04
证据

参考实现声称在特定配置下于长记忆评测取得百分之九十二、在另一项长期对话评测取得百分之九十三点二，并分析线性成本与保真压缩的关系。

摘要

文章认为，生产代理的主要失败来源往往不是推理能力不足，而是无法管理不断增长的对话历史、提示词、工具定义和工具输出，因此上下文管理应被视为涵盖记忆选择、结构化、分层存储、范围控制、需求预判、压缩、整合与遗忘的生命周期。文章提出由五个基本操作组成的代理上下文管理学科，介绍一个多租户参考实现，并声称其在两项长记忆评测中分别达到百分之九十二和百分之九十三点二，同时指出现有基准还缺少延迟、标记效率和上下文衰减抗性等维度。

主题multi-agent systems

05
论文 / 高优先级

IDEAgent: Agentic Quality-Diversity Search for Research Idea Generation

分类主题multi-agent systems
Varun Gumma, Navonil Majumder, Soumitra Sinhahajari, Soujanya Poria
high · 2026-07-24

为什么值得看 它把多智能体科研构思从只追求质量或多样性改成沿思想谱系同时搜索两者，并用修复、精炼和历史记忆减少空泛方案；对需要批量生成且彼此差异明显的研究假设的智能体系统尤其有价值。

来源信号arXiv 收录Hugging Face Daily Papers（社区点赞 👍 3）
代码
方法解读
01
问题

现有科研构思系统通常独立优化质量或多样性，因而容易产生相近想法或大量琐碎、不可靠和含糊的概念。

02
方法

该系统通过多智能体管理思想谱系，用多目标反馈进行修复与精炼，并借助顺序记忆比较已完成想法、祖先想法和被拒方案。

03
差异

它将科研构思明确建模为质量与多样性的质量—多样性联合搜索，并提出衡量两者交集的产出指标。

04
证据

在覆盖计算机科学八个领域、三十二个主题的评测中，该系统的产出指标达到最佳基线的三点八九倍，并在八倍数量的主题上取得非零产出。

摘要

论文指出，现有大语言模型科研构思系统通常分别优化质量或多样性，导致想法彼此接近，或产生大量琐碎、不可靠和含糊的概念；因此将构思过程视为质量与多样性并重的质量—多样性搜索。其多智能体系统通过思想谱系、多目标修复与精炼、顺序记忆和与历史及被拒想法的显式比较来演化想法，并提出联合指标评估达到质量阈值且彼此多样的最大想法集合；在三十二个主题上，该系统相较最佳基线将指标提高三点八九倍，并在八倍数量的主题上取得非零结果。

4 位作者1 所机构3 条合作线

主题agent evaluation / benchmarks

06
论文 / 高优先级

The Regression Tax: Decomposing Why Skills Help and Hurt LLM Agents

分类主题agent evaluation / benchmarks
Darshan Tank, Baran Nama
high · 2026-07-24

为什么值得看 它用近六千次跨基准运行表明，技能带来的可靠性主要取决于少制造回归，而非多增加成功，并指出接地与验证比程序步骤本身更值得优先设计。

来源信号arXiv 收录
方法解读
01
问题

研究技能加入后为何会让原本成功的任务失败，以及为何另一些任务始终失败。

02
方法

作者在两个办公自动化基准和三种模型代理栈上，对比带技能与不带技能的代理表现并分析运行轨迹。

03
差异

方法把失败区分为技能导致的回归和两种设置下都失败的残余失败，而不是只看总体成功率。

04
证据

该工作提出一个以莱恩证明助手为基础的因果推断理论研究自动化框架，将包含七千零三十五项机器检查声明的基础库与可自我改进的代理流程结合起来。流程负责选题、提出结果、形式化陈述、构造证明和整理供人检查的产物，并通过陈述审计弥补机器证明只能保证假设推出形式命题、不能保证命题符合预期科学含义的缺陷；系统依据自主运行产物进行评估。

A Self-Calibrating Agentic AI Framework for Autonomous Edge Resource Allocation

分类主题agent safety / robustness
Fin Gentzen, Marla Grunewald, Iulisloi Zacarias, Mounir Bensalem, Admela Jukan
high · 2026-07-24

为什么值得看 它把漂移监测和时间序列预测嵌入自主代理，使代理在缺少持续人工监督和明确真值的边缘资源分配场景中仍能校准决策，并报告了相对基线代理资源预测准确率提升91.7%、预测速度提升71.7%。

来源信号arXiv 收录
方法解读
01
问题

论文研究开放环境中缺少可靠真值且长期运行会发生漂移的代理系统可靠性问题，并将其落到边缘网络零知识工作负载的资源使用画像。

02
方法

框架使用自校准机制和自回归积分滑动平均预测器动态近似真值，以支持无需持续人工监督的资源预测。

03
差异

它将时间序列预测驱动的真值近似和漂移缓解直接纳入大语言模型代理运行流程，而不是只依赖纯画像或未经校准的语言模型代理。

04
证据

实验显示资源使用预测准确率比基线语言模型代理高91.7%、预测速度比纯画像快71.7%，其跳跃式预测算法在相同准确率下比标准算法快52%。

摘要

论文提出并实验评估一种面向大语言模型代理的自校准框架，通过结合自回归积分滑动平均预测器缓解运行漂移并动态近似真值，无需持续人工监督。框架应用于边缘计算网络中的零知识工作负载资源画像，相比基线代理提高资源使用预测准确率91.7%并将预测速度提高71.7%；其真值生成算法在保持相同准确率的同时比标准预测算法快52%。

medium · 2026-07-24

为什么值得看 它把数据集成中的检索增强生成从固定检索推进到可规划、可迭代的多智能体流程，并同时关注证据可核验与企业规模下的成本控制，适合研究可靠知识增强代理的人参考。

来源信号arXiv 收录
方法解读
01
问题

论文关注企业数据集成中知识缺口导致的准确性、幻觉与计算成本问题。

02
方法

论文梳理经典检索增强生成、图检索增强生成和知识图谱检索增强生成，并讨论多智能体自适应规划、检索、精炼与推理的流程。

03
差异

相较于固定的检索增强生成，所讨论的代理式流程会针对复杂集成任务动态调整检索和推理步骤。

04
证据

文章主要给出方法演进、成本优化方向和开放问题的综述性分析，摘要未报告具体实验结果。

摘要

大型语言模型和人工智能代理已在零样本与少样本数据集成中展现潜力，但企业环境中的知识缺口仍带来准确性和成本问题。论文将可信数据集成描述为基于知识的语言模型与代理在检索增强生成流程中进行证据支撑、可验证且抗幻觉的推理，并梳理从经典检索增强生成、图检索增强生成和知识图谱检索增强生成到代理式检索增强生成的演进，同时讨论大规模企业场景下的成本优化、可靠性、可解释性和扩展性挑战。

Explainable Reinforcement Learning for assisting Air Traffic Controllers

分类主题agent safety / robustness
Anduel Mehmeti, Gabriella Gigante, Salvatore Venticinque
medium · 2026-07-24

为什么值得看 它把可解释性引入安全关键的强化学习决策，并用显著性图显示哪些输入特征影响航线选择，为研究可审查、可建立信任的智能体提供了一个航空管制测试场景。

方法解读
01
问题

研究如何让用于避免禁飞区的强化学习航线决策在空中交通管制中更容易被人理解和信任。

02
方法

在简化的空中交通管制环境中训练智能体选择替代航线，并用显著性图分析输入特征对决策的影响。

03
差异

该工作将解释技术直接用于安全关键的强化学习场景，而不是只评估航线决策结果。

04
证据

摘要

本文探讨在安全关键的空中交通管制领域，将可解释性技术应用于强化学习算法。研究在简化环境中训练智能体选择避开禁飞区的替代航线，并使用显著性图识别最影响决策的输入特征，以初步了解其决策依据。

CARA: Concept-Aware Risk Attention for Interpretable Collision Anticipation

Zhishan Tao, Ruoyu Wang, Yucheng Wu, Enjun Du, Yilei Yuan, Sherwin Ho et al.
low · 2026-07-24

为什么值得看 它把事故叙事提炼出的动态风险概念直接接入视频注意力和碰撞预测，而不是事后生成解释，但对语言模型智能体的工具使用、规划或计算机操作帮助很有限。

来源信号arXiv 收录
方法解读
01
问题

自动驾驶碰撞预警既要提前且准确，也要说明正在跟踪哪些风险因素及其如何随时间变化。

02
方法

方法从事故叙事中提取风险概念，用视觉语言相似度将概念对齐到视频帧，并构建随时间演化的概念轨迹来引导空间注意力、时间注意力和风险预测。

03
差异

它将语义风险因素作为预测过程中的动态中间证据，而不是仅用于事后解释或静态识别。

04
证据

在三个基准上的实验据称持续提升预警准确性和提前量，并产生稀疏且具有语义依据的概念证据。

摘要

碰撞预警需要在尽早发出准确警告的同时，解释所跟踪的风险因素及其随时间的变化；现有特征模型、事后解释和面向静态识别的概念方法难以满足这一要求。该方法从事故叙事中提取风险概念，将其与视频帧对齐并组织成动态概念轨迹，使概念证据直接影响时空注意力和风险预测；三个基准上的实验据称表明，它提升了预警准确性和提前量，并提供稀疏、语义明确的风险证据。

Masked Visual Actions for Unified World Modeling

high · 2026-07-21

方法解读
01
问题

视频模型缺少一种既贴合视觉表征又能落到物理操作上的动作接口。

02

ABot-World-0: Infinite Interactive World Rollout on a Single Desktop GPU

分类主题video / generative world models
Fan Jiang, Zhaoxu Sun, Mengchao Wang, Ziyu Zhu, Chiyu Wang, Yunpeng Zhang et al.
high · 2026-07-21

为什么值得看 它把动作条件视频世界模型从短片生成推进到单张桌面级显卡上的实时长时闭环交互，并用长时教师蒸馏、行动数据基础设施和低比特流式推理同时缓解自回归漂移与部署成本，直接服务于可玩游戏世界和模型驱动智能体研究。

来源信号Hugging Face Daily Papers（社区点赞 👍 298）
代码
方法解读
01
问题

论文要学习能由动作控制、支持实时长时闭环交互的世界动力学，并处理长时自回归漂移与分布偏移。

02
方法

系统从大型游戏、模拟引擎和互联网视频收集数据，将双向动作条件教师通过教师强制与常微分方程蒸馏为因果学生，并用长时蒸馏、角色记忆和原始键盘动作增强控制。

03
差异

它把面向场景漫游和第三人称角色交互的统一键盘控制、长时学生自回滚对齐和面向流式部署的推理栈整合到同一世界模型中。

04
证据

在单张英伟达锐龙五零九零桌面显卡上，系统可输出七百二十像素视频、最高每秒十六帧，动作到首帧延迟为一点二秒、峰值显存约十九吉字节，并在交互基准和长时回滚中展示了竞争性的可控性与演化连贯性。

摘要

论文提出阿博特世界零号，一种动作条件视频世界模型，利用覆盖大型游戏、模拟引擎和互联网视频的多源数据学习可控世界动力学，并通过智能体驱动的数据采集、质量检查和同步动作文本标注构建训练基础设施。模型将双向动作条件教师蒸馏为因果学生，以长时蒸馏减轻累积分布偏移和自回归漂移；配合轻量解码器、高效注意力、显存感知调度和低比特推理后，它可在单张桌面级显卡上以最高每秒十六帧流式生成七百二十像素视频，并在交互评测和长时回滚中保持可控性与世界演化连贯性。

AlayaWorld: Interactive Long-Horizon World Modeling -- Full Technical Report

分类主题video / generative world models
AlayaWorld Team, Kaipeng Zhang, Chuanhao Li, Yifan Zhan, Yongtao Ge, Yuanyang Yin et al.
high · 2026-07-20

为什么值得看 它把交互控制、持久空间记忆、长时生成抗漂移和低步数推理整合到同一视频世界模型中，使研究者能在文本、图像或视频条件下探索更长时间且可持续响应的虚拟环境。

来源信号Hugging Face Daily Papers（社区点赞 👍 57）
代码
方法解读
01
问题

视频世界模型需要同时解决交互响应、时空一致性、长时稳定生成和推理效率问题。

02
方法

模型以一百五十亿参数的视频扩散变换器为基础，在相机轨迹和可切换文本提示下自回归生成短潜变量块，并结合持久首帧、压缩历史、几何对齐空间记忆和近期帧条件。

03
差异

模型用自身 rollout 收集的受扰历史与预测残差训练抗漂移能力，并以分布匹配蒸馏、自强制增强和一致性蒸馏把每块采样步数从约三十步降至四步。

04
证据

在世界基准上，作者报告其长时生成性能最佳，并能以每秒二十四帧生成五百四十像素和七百二十像素视频。

摘要

阿拉雅世界是一个面向交互式长时生成的视频世界模型，基于一百五十亿参数的视频扩散变换器，在相机轨迹和可切换文本提示下自回归生成短潜变量块，并通过持久首帧、压缩时间历史、几何对齐空间记忆和近期帧条件维持视觉一致性。模型使用自身 rollout 的受扰历史与预测残差降低长期漂移，并通过离散自回归蒸馏将每个视频块的推理采样从约三十步减少到四步；作者报告其在世界基准的长时生成上取得最佳性能。

high · 2026-07-21

为什么值得看 它把物理引擎输出的结构化世界状态转成可交互的生成画面，并将渲染速度从每秒零点五六帧提升到每秒三十一点五四帧，使生成式世界模型首次具备接近实际游玩的连续运行能力。

来源信号Hugging Face Daily Papers（社区点赞 👍 78）
代码
方法解读
01
问题

原始渲染器计算开销过高，无法满足实时部署和连续游玩需求。

02
方法

方法将教师渲染器改写为少步自回归流式模型，并使用轻量级蒸馏编解码器完成潜变量编码与画面重建。

03
差异

它直接接收物理引擎的图形缓冲区和文本提示接口，同时支持无界长度输入流的连续渲染，而不是依赖逐帧独立生成。

04
证据

在图形缓冲区流上评估了内容保持、时间一致性、跨窗口稳定性、提示可控性和运行效率，并与物理引擎结合实现了每秒三十帧的可玩生成世界。

摘要

AlayaRenderer从物理引擎导出的结构化世界状态合成彩色画面，在保持场景结构和底层世界动力学不变的同时支持文本提示与图形缓冲区控制。该技术报告提出面向实时运行的少步自回归流式版本和轻量级蒸馏编解码器，将速度从每秒零点五六帧提升至每秒三十一点五四帧，并在物理引擎中实现了每秒三十帧的可玩生成世界。

为什么值得看 它把大规模第一视角操作视频、手部姿态、相机轨迹和原子动作统一成可训练数据，并提供面向世界模型的转换工具，降低了从人类示范学习具身动态模型的数据准备门槛。

来源信号Hugging Face Daily Papers（社区点赞 👍 68）

方法解读
01
问题

现有具身学习资源通常不能同时提供低成本连续采集、操作级结构化标注和可复用的机器人学习工具。

02
方法

该工作汇集五百多名贡献者用四百多部智能手机采集约两千小时视频，并通过动作分段、语义标注、手部重建和相机轨迹重建生成结构化样本。

03
差异

它将从手机采集到模型训练的完整流程开源，并额外支持跨身体迁移、模型格式转换以及视觉语言动作策略、世界模型和其他具身模型的训练。

04
证据

首个版本包含文本标注、基于手部模型的手姿态、相机轨迹和时间定位的原子动作，但摘要未报告具体模型性能提升。

摘要

开放式第一视角操作数据集与工具链旨在解决具身学习中数据采集、结构化处理和下游复用难以衔接的问题。首个版本包含由五百多名贡献者使用四百多部智能手机采集的约两千小时自然环境操作视频，并提供文本标注、基于手部模型的手姿态、相机轨迹和原子动作；配套流程覆盖动作分段、语义标注、手部重建和相机轨迹重建，工具链支持可视化、跨身体迁移、模型转换以及视觉语言动作策略、世界模型等训练。

high · 2026-07-23

为什么值得看 它把多智能体视频生成从携带观测历史推进到显式维护可更新的共享世界状态，并用跨视角与全局状态监督提升逻辑一致性，直接回应了多主体世界模型难以保持持久状态的问题。

来源信号arXiv 收录Hugging Face Daily Papers（社区点赞 👍 12）
方法解读
01
问题

现有自回归视频扩散模型依赖观测历史作为条件，在多智能体、多视角生成中难以维持共享且持久的世界状态。

02
方法

模型在每个生成片段后动态更新跨智能体世界状态寄存器，并以个体状态、鸟瞰等全局视图和场景文本进行监督。

03
差异

混合变换器架构为世界状态建模和视觉帧建模使用分离的参数，而不是只延续观测序列。

04
证据

在双智能体《我的世界》视频生成实验中，作者报告显式世界状态建模改善了逻辑一致性和生成质量。

摘要

作者提出一种流式多智能体视频扩散模型，通过跨智能体世界状态寄存器保存共享世界信息、跟踪个体状态，并在每个生成片段后动态更新。模型还使用分离世界状态与视觉帧建模参数的混合变换器架构，并结合个体状态、鸟瞰等全局视图和场景文本监督；在双智能体《我的世界》视频生成实验中，显式世界状态建模提升了逻辑一致性和生成质量。
